remarks: Welcome to 147 Lockwood Avenue, a spacious two-family home located in the heart of South Buffalo. Offering generous room sizes and functional layouts in both units, this property presents an excellent opportunity for owner-occupants or investors alike. The lower unit features 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, while the upper unit offers 3 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. Both apartments showcase spacious, open kitchens with walk-in pantries, providing ample cabinet and storage space. Cozy carpeting adds warmth to the living areas, while hardwood flooring in the bedrooms brings timeless character and charm. Recent improvements include brand-new windows throughout, updated electrical service, fresh interior paint, and a brand new front porch. A full basement and full attic provide additional storage and utility space, offering flexibility for a variety of needs. Situated just minutes from South Buffalo's restaurants, parks, shopping, and major commuter routes, this property offers convenience for both owner-occupants and investors alike. Open house Wednesday, July 29th from 5-7pm and Sunday from 11-1pm. Offers will be reviewed as they come in.
